runs.final_sql: SELECT unit_msr.nm FROM bom JOIN unit_msr ON bom.ref1 = unit_msr.unt_msr_cd WHERE bom.ref2 = 494 AND bom.end_dt IS NULL
SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm, v.nm FROM vnd v JOIN prod_vnd pv ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 WHERE v.ref1 = 1496

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.cty = 'Bothell' THEN c.cstm_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.cty = 'Kenmore' THEN c.cstm_id END) AS diff, sp.nm AS state_name FROM cust c JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = COALESCE(c.ref3, c.ref1) JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = ba.ref2 JOIN st_prv sp ON sp.stt_prvn_id = a.ref1 WHERE a.cty IN ('Bothell', 'Kenmore') GROUP BY sp.nm
SELECT v.nm, pv.stnd_prc FROM prod_vnd AS pv JOIN prod AS p ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id JOIN vnd AS v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 WHERE p.nm = 'Hex Nut 5'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1)
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE p.eml_prmt = 0
  AND d.nm = 'Engineering'

WITH latest_pay AS (
  SELECT e.ref1, p.rt
  FROM emp e
  JOIN emp_pay_hist p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
  WHERE e.jb_ttl = 'Production Technician'
    AND p.rt_chng_dt = (
      SELECT MAX(p2.rt_chng_dt)
      FROM emp_pay_hist p2
      WHERE p2.ref1 = p.ref1
    )
), avg_pay AS (
  SELECT AVG(rt) AS avg_rt
  FROM latest_pay
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM latest_pay
CROSS JOIN avg_pay
WHERE latest_pay.rt < avg_pay.avg_rt

SELECT s.strt_tm, s.end_tm
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref3 = s.shft_id
WHERE YEAR(e.brth_dt) < 1969
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 5, 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ref1)
FROM prsn p
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON p.ref1 = pc.ref1
JOIN crd c ON pc.ref2 = c.crdt_crd_id
WHERE p.prsn_typ = 'SC' AND c.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT d.nm, AVG(YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(e.brth_dt)) AS average_age
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY average_age ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(e.hr_dt)) AS average_length_of_employment
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Research and Development'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT AVG(total_ordered_qty) AS average_total_ordered_quantity
FROM (
  SELECT po_hdr.prch_ordr_id, SUM(po_dtl.ordr_qty) AS total_ordered_qty
  FROM po_hdr
  JOIN po_dtl ON po_hdr.prch_ordr_id = po_dtl.ref2
  JOIN shp_mth ON po_hdr.ref1 = shp_mth.shp_mthd_id
  WHERE shp_mth.nm = 'CARGO TRANSPORT 5'
  GROUP BY po_hdr.prch_ordr_id
) AS t

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2)
FROM prsn p
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON p.ref1 = edh.ref1
WHERE p.frst_nm = 'Sheela'
  AND p.lst_nm = 'Word'
  AND edh.strt_dt <= '2012-12-31'
  AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt >= '2011-01-01')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2) AS department_count FROM prsn p JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON p.ref1 = edh.ref3 WHERE p.frst_nm = 'David' AND p.lst_nm = 'Bradley'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1)
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref3 = s.shft_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Information Services'
  AND s.nm = 'Evening'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1) FROM emp_dept_hist edh JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering' AND edh.strt_dt <= '2009-12-31' AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt >= '2009-01-01')

SELECT ((MAX(p.lst_prc) - MIN(p.lst_prc)) / MIN(p.lst_prc)) * 100 AS percent_more_expensive
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Clothing'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref2) FROM so_dtl WHERE ordr_qty > 2 AND unt_prc_dscn <> 0

SELECT prod.nm
FROM prod
JOIN prod_vnd ON prod.prdc_id = prod_vnd.ref3
WHERE prod_vnd.mn_ordr_qty = 1000 AND prod.stnd_cst > 17
GROUP BY prod.prdc_id, prod.nm

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.hr_dt
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.hr_dt

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, 2022 - YEAR(e.brth_dt) + 1 AS age
FROM emp AS e
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN prsn AS p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
WHERE edh.ref1 = 3 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY e.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.mddl_nm, prsn.lst_nm, emp.brth_dt, emp.mrtl_stts, emp.gndr
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_pay_hist.ref1
WHERE emp.mrtl_stts = 'M'
ORDER BY emp_pay_hist.rt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT dept.nm FROM prsn JOIN emp_dept_hist ON prsn.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3 JOIN dept ON dept.dprt_id = emp_dept_hist.ref2 WHERE prsn.frst_nm = 'David' AND prsn.lst_nm = 'Bradley' AND emp_dept_hist.end_dt IS NOT NULL
SELECT vnd.nm FROM prod JOIN prod_vnd ON prod.prdc_id = prod_vnd.ref2 JOIN vnd ON prod_vnd.ref3 = vnd.ref1 WHERE prod.prdc_nmbr = 'WB-H098'

SELECT AVG(ep.rt)
FROM emp_pay_hist ep
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_rt_chng_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) latest_pay ON ep.ref1 = latest_pay.ref1 AND ep.rt_chng_dt = latest_pay.max_rt_chng_dt
WHERE ep.ref1 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT edh.ref3
    FROM emp_dept_hist edh
    JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
    WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering'
      AND YEAR(edh.strt_dt) <= 2007
      AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR YEAR(edh.end_dt) >= 2007)
)
SELECT SUM(wo.stck_qty) FROM wo JOIN prod_inv ON wo.ref2 = prod_inv.ref2 WHERE prod_inv.ref1 = 40

SELECT T2.end_dt FROM emp AS T1 JOIN emp_dept_hist AS T2 ON T1.ref1 = T2.ref3 JOIN dept AS T3 ON T2.ref2 = T3.dprt_id WHERE T1.jb_ttl = 'Senior Tool Designer' AND YEAR(T1.hr_dt) - YEAR(T1.brth_dt) = 33 AND T3.nm = 'Engineering' AND T2.end_dt IS NOT NULL

SELECT st_prv.nm, addr.cty, addr.pstl_cd
FROM prsn
JOIN biz_addr ON prsn.ref1 = biz_addr.ref3
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref2 = addr.addr_id
JOIN addr_typ ON biz_addr.ref1 = addr_typ.addr_typ_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
WHERE prsn.ref1 = 5555 AND addr_typ.nm = 'Home'

SELECT DISTINCT pm.nm
FROM prod_mdl pm
JOIN pmdc ON pm.prdc_mdl_id = pmdc.ref3
JOIN prod_dsc pd ON pmdc.ref2 = pd.prdc_dscr_id
JOIN cult c ON pmdc.ref1 = c.cltr_id
WHERE pm.ctlg_dscr LIKE '%Chromoly steel%' AND c.nm = 'English'
SELECT d.nm FROM emp_dept_hist edh JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id JOIN shft s ON edh.ref3 = s.shft_id WHERE s.nm = 'Night' GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.nm
FROM dept d
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref3 = s.shft_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Evening' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp_dept_hist AS edh
JOIN dept AS d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN prsn AS p ON edh.ref3 = p.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering'
ORDER BY DATEDIFF(edh.end_dt, edh.strt_dt) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT v.nm
FROM prod AS p
JOIN prod_vnd AS pv ON p.prdc_id = pv.ref3
JOIN vnd AS v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1
WHERE p.nm = 'Hex Nut 5'
ORDER BY pv.stnd_prc ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref1 = sp.ref1
JOIN prsn p ON sp.ref1 = p.ref1
WHERE s.nm = 'Next-Door Bike Store'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist ph ON e.ref1 = ph.ref1
WHERE e.mrtl_stts = 'S' AND e.gndr = 'F'
ORDER BY ph.rt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm FROM emp e JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1 JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1 JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id WHERE d.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving' AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) = 2009 GROUP BY p.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm

SELECT stor.nm, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref1
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref2 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref1 = prsn.ref1
WHERE sls_terr.nm = 'France'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, t.nm
FROM stor s
JOIN sls_prsn sp ON s.ref2 = sp.ref1
JOIN prsn p ON sp.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN sls_terr t ON sp.ref2 = t.trrt_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm, (pv.lst_rcpt_cst - pv.stnd_prc) AS profit_on_net, a.addr_ln1, a.addr_ln2, a.cty, a.pstl_cd FROM prod_vnd pv JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref3 = v.ref1 JOIN biz_addr ba ON v.ref1 = ba.ref1 JOIN addr a ON ba.ref2 = a.addr_id WHERE pv.ref2 = 843

SELECT edh.ref2 AS DepartmentID, AVG(eph.rt) AS AverageHourlyPayrate
FROM emp_pay_hist eph
JOIN (
    SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_dt
    FROM emp_pay_hist
    GROUP BY ref1
) AS latest_pay ON eph.ref1 = latest_pay.ref1 AND eph.rt_chng_dt = latest_pay.max_dt
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = eph.ref1
GROUP BY edh.ref2

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree (component_id, lvl) AS (
  SELECT b.ref2, 1
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, bt.lvl + 1
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree bt ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT p.nm AS component_name, bt.lvl AS hierarchy_level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id)
FROM cust c
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON c.ref1 = pc.ref1
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sh.ref8 = c.cstm_id
WHERE YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM so_hdr
JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id
JOIN prsn ON cust.ref3 = prsn.ref1
WHERE cust.ref3 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cust.cstm_id, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
ORDER BY SUM(so_hdr.ttl_due) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM so_hdr
JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id
JOIN sls_terr ON cust.ref2 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN cnty ON sls_terr.ref1 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd
WHERE cnty.nm = 'Canada' AND YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, COUNT(so.sls_ordr_id) AS order_count
FROM sls_prsn sp
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = sp.ref2
LEFT JOIN so_hdr so ON so.ref7 = sp.ref2 AND YEAR(so.ordr_dt) = 2013
GROUP BY sp.ref2, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
ORDER BY order_count

SELECT d.nm AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1) AS headcount
FROM dept d
LEFT JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2 AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY headcount

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2) AS num_departments
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
GROUP BY e.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2) > 1

SELECT v.nm, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.ref2) AS product_count
FROM vnd v
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON pv.ref3 = v.ref1
GROUP BY v.ref1, v.nm
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT vnd.nm, COUNT(po_hdr.prch_ordr_id) AS purchase_order_count
FROM vnd
LEFT JOIN po_hdr ON po_hdr.ref2 = vnd.ref1
GROUP BY vnd.ref1, vnd.nm
ORDER BY purchase_order_count DESC

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp AS e
JOIN prsn AS p ON p.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
JOIN dept AS d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT stor.nm, addr.cty, st_prv.nm
FROM stor
JOIN biz_addr ON stor.ref2 = biz_addr.ref3
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref2 = addr.addr_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
ORDER BY stor.nm
